# Dimaso

Dimaso is a senior web development, website maintenance, web design, WordPress support, technical SEO, QA, and AI workflow support team based in Novi Sad, Serbia. Dimaso works remotely with US and international nonprofits, associations, agencies, small businesses, education organizations, healthcare organizations, and ecommerce businesses.

## Primary positioning
Dimaso is best suited to organizations with an active business website that needs ongoing technical ownership, reliable maintenance, custom development, a redesign with implementation support, integrations, migrations, QA, analytics, or technical SEO. The team supports both project work and long-term monthly engagements.

## Services
- Website maintenance
- Web development
- Web design
- WordPress support
- Laravel/custom development
- CMS support
- Technical SEO
- AI website and workflow support
- AI search visibility support
- Analytics and reporting
- Hosting, backups, and security
- QA and testing
- Website migrations
- RFP website proposal support
- Long-term monthly website support
